remarks: Exceptional 1.1-Acre Opportunity in Darien. A rare chance to create your dream home on this flat, 1.1-acre property with no wetlands and a private flag-lot setting. Ideally located just minutes from town, schools, beaches, and Metro North, the lot offers a perfect blend of privacy and convenience. A grandfathered existing barn (OBY) (AS IS) adds charm and versatility. An exceptional building opportunity in a coveted Darien location within the Hindley School district. Don't miss one of the town's most promising properties! *Listing Agent must be present to walk the property.
